title: Merge Two 2D Arrays by Summing Values
summary: Given two 2D integer arrays, nums1 and nums2, each containing unique ids sorted in ascending order by id, merge them into one array sorted by id.
statement: Given two 2D integer arrays, nums1 and nums2, each containing unique ids sorted in ascending order by id, merge them into one array sorted by id. Include only ids present in at least one array, summing their values. If an id is missing in one array, assume its value to be zero. The merged array must also be sorted in ascending order by id.
constraints: Each entry is [id,value], with unique ids within each input array.
For each id, sum values contributed by both arrays.
Return [id,total] entries in increasing id order.
hints: Accumulate values in a dictionary keyed by id.
Process entries from both arrays into the same map.
Build output by iterating sorted ids.
Every contribution is added exactly once to its id, and sorted keys enforce the required order.
editorial: Every contribution is added exactly once to its id, and sorted keys enforce the required order.

tests.explanation: Ids one and four combine across inputs, producing [[1,6],[2,3],[3,2],[4,6]].
Distinct ids are preserved and sorted as [[1,3],[2,4]].
